system.description: Like the Eat Food Merit but twice as versatile: you can ingest and taste food and drink, gain no nutritional benefit from it, but can store it for later use and disgorge it with a degree of precision. To hit someone or something with this nasty missile, you must succeed in a Physical Challenge; your victim may resist normally (modifiers for dodging and cover apply). It causes no direct damage, but may obscure vision, cause a slip, or otherwise humiliate the target.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
